desc: Define cycle orientation x_i and derive d_i = 1 + x_{i-1} - x_i + w_i for i<N, with d_N forced by the prefix sum (answer = # achievable prefixes).
Model achievable prefixes as the 2-state NFA and build the relation-determinization automaton (12 reachable relations A..M), collapsing to 7 symmetric variables.
Implement the O(N) 7-state unrolled DP with modulo every 64 steps; it passes both public samples (N=3 "010" -> 14 and N=20 -> 261339902).
Verified correctness and performance (O(N) time, O(1) memory, fits constraints up to N=10^6).
